defaults.unit: One coherent question per recipe; file manipulation, plotting and scalar summaries should normally be stages in a connected biological analysis.
defaults.reward: Use a native input-reading baseline and deterministic schema/numeric/structural checks. Learned predictions may vary: grade a frozen held-out metric and complete prediction identities rather than exact model outputs. Calibrate any success criterion before solver attempts. No LLM judge.
defaults.plotting: Validate complete plotting data, axes, units, labels and required graphical elements. A checked source table alone does not prove the rendered plot is correct; visual-style equivalence remains unresolved where it cannot be checked faithfully.
defaults.data_reality: Real observed input sequences, measurements, cohorts and images. Designed sequence outputs are labelled computational designs; simulated nulls or uncertainty draws are analysis procedures, never substituted for observed biological inputs.
defaults.consolidation: These 80 proposals overlap the earlier benchmark-specific cards. Merge only when input types, scientific estimands and required native methods agree; do not sum proposal counts into dataset size.
